name: cmdproto
description: Proto-first ABI boundary toolkit for strict human and machine command interfaces.

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p dist/wasm && cd tools/buf-plugin-cmdproto && GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -o ../../dist/wasm/cmdproto-buf-plugin.wasm ./cmd/buf-plugin-cmdproto && GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -o ../../dist/wasm/cmdproto-runtime-manifest.wasm ./cmd/runtime-manifest
scripts.schema:build: buf lint --config buf.yaml && mkdir -p dist && buf build --config buf.yaml proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o dist/schema.binpb && node ./scripts/runtime-manifest.mjs --app-name app --schema dist/schema.binpb --out dist/runtime.binpb
scripts.schema:build:greeter: buf lint --config buf.yaml examples/greeter/proto && mkdir -p examples/greeter/dist && buf build --config buf.yaml examples/greeter/proto --as-file-descriptor-set -o examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb && node ./scripts/runtime-manifest.mjs --app-name greeter --schema examples/greeter/dist/schema.binpb --out examples/greeter/dist/runtime.binpb
scripts.check: npm run build:wasm && buf lint && npm run schema:build && npm run schema:build:greeter && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:plugin
